description: This PHP source file defines the ValidateProjectNameAPI class within the OrangeHRM application, specifically in the Time plugin API module. It provides an API endpoint to validate the uniqueness of a project name, allowing clients to check if a project name is already taken, optionally considering a project ID and customer ID. The class extends an Endpoint and implements ResourceEndpoint, utilizing traits and dependencies to access project data. It includes request validation rules, API documentation annotations, and logic to fetch project information and determine name availability.
